label: Accessible name of a Space's Settings tab. {{space}} is the Space's name. "Space" is a product noun (a shared area of pages).
description: Subtitle under the Space's name on its Settings tab.
loading: On a Space's Settings tab while its settings and people load.
audience-legend: Legend of the two radio cards that choose who sees the Space (the whole workspace, or only its people).
audience-note: Shown to a Space's members who can't change who sees it; the _private form for a private Space. Its list of what a private Space covers matches the other audience texts.
delete.title: Heading of the danger zone at the foot of the Space's settings.
delete.body: Explains what deleting the Space takes with it. "socios" are AI agents; app shares are apps shared with the Space.
delete.action: Destructive button that opens the delete confirmation.
confirm.title: Confirmation dialog title when changing who sees the Space: _private makes it private, the base form opens it to everyone.
confirm.action: The confirmation dialog's button: _private makes the Space private, the base form opens it to everyone.
confirm.body: The confirmation dialog's body: _private for making the Space private ("socios" are AI agents), the base form for opening it.
name.title: Heading of the rename form.
name.label: Accessible name of the Space name text box.
name.rename: Button (Space editors only) that saves the Space's new name.
people.title: Heading of the list of the Space's people.
people.hint: Explains the two Space roles, Editor and Member.
people.role-of: Accessible name of a person's role picker. {{name}} is the person's name.
people.remove: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that removes a person from the Space. {{name}} is the person's name.
people.add-form: Accessible name of the form that adds a person to the Space.
people.person-to-add: Accessible name of the picker of the person to add.
people.role: Accessible name of the role picker for the person being added.
people.add: Button that adds the chosen person.
people.load-failed: Error toast when the Space's people couldn't load.
roles.editor: Space role name, shown in pickers and as a badge: may edit the Space and manage its people.
roles.member: Space role name, shown in pickers and as a badge: reads the Space and proposes.
